# Force Open Treaty Ports
oe_war2_pt_open_treaty_ports = {
	blocks_full_annexation = yes
	category = country

	cost = {
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 28
		}
	}

	base_antagonism = 7
	antagonism_type = antagonism_trade_wars

	potential = {
		scope:loser = {
			num_of_ports >= 1
			country_economical_base >= 15
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:loser = {
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_ports_loser }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_war2_apply_pt_open_treaty_ports = yes
	}

	ai_desire = {
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:winner = { num_of_ports >= 3 } }
			add = {
				desc = "OE_WAR2_AI_MARITIME_INTEREST"
				value = 12
			}
		}
	}
}

# Dismantle Frontier Fortresses

	blocks_full_annexation = yes
	category = country

	cost = {

			value = 30
		}
	}

	base_antagonism = 8
	antagonism_type = antagonism_dismantle_fortifications

	potential = {
		scope:loser = {
			any_fort_in_country = { has_fort = yes }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:loser = {
			any_fort_in_country = { has_fort = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_forts_loser }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_war2_apply_pt_raze_border_forts = yes
	}

		add = {

			}

}

# Impose Sovereign Court Language
oe_war2_pt_impose_court_language = {
	blocks_full_annexation = yes
	category = country

	cost = {
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 32
		}
	}

	base_antagonism = 8
	antagonism_type = antagonism_peace_treaty_demands

	potential = {
		scope:loser = {
			NOT = { court_dialect = scope:winner.court_dialect }
			NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:papacy_reform }
			NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:kingdom_of_god_reform }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:loser = {
			NOT = { court_dialect = scope:winner.court_dialect }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_language_loser }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_war2_apply_pt_impose_court_language = yes
	}

	ai_desire = {
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:winner = { is_great_power = yes } }
			add = {
				desc = "OE_WAR2_AI_IMPERIAL_PRESTIGE"
				value = 10
			}
		}
	}
}
